title: Public form /f/:slug crashes for every visitor (React error #31) when a form entry's label, placeholder or helpText is the spec's inline locale map (I18nLabel { en, zh-CN })
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 公共表单的条目 `label`（以及 placeholder / helpText）写成规范允许的内联多语言对象 `{ en, 'zh-CN' }` 时，`/_console/f/:slug` 对所有访客白屏（React #31）。服务端原样透传，控制台没有把它解析成文字。
- **要做：** 公共表单（和同一渲染器的内部表单）按访客语言把这类对象解析成字符串再渲染。
- **完成标准：** 写内联多语言 label 的表单正常打开，en 与 zh-CN 访客各看到自己的文字。

Filing gate **① a measured defect**, found by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) while executing objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2248. The measurement is on that card, comment `6367313756`. ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` the public door `/_console/f/:slug`, measured in a browser as an anonymous visitor (white page, React error #31). The metadata is spec-valid: `FormFieldBaseSchema` types an entry's `label`, `placeholder` and `helpText` as `I18nLabelSchema` (`@objectstack/spec` `src/ui/view.zod.ts` ~:3536–3538 on objectstack `origin/main` `2581efbcbd`), so it parses and publishes clean.

**Suggested grade: `priority:p2`** (the seat's reading; grade, `domain:*` and `area:*` are objectui triage's), in line with the inline-locale-map family (#12358, #12757, #12688, #12936, all p2). This one is worse in kind, since the whole page is lost, not one string, but no shipped app writes the shape today: HotCRM's probe was local and reverted.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage, then the `domain:ui` lane.

## Measured

On `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (`@objectstack/console` 18.0.0), HotCRM `origin/main` `c14ffde`, a local probe (reverted):

- The `web_to_case` form (slug `support`) gave one section entry `label: { en: 'Your name', 'zh-CN': '…' }`.
- `GET /api/v1/forms/support` serves the map unchanged (`@objectstack/rest`, the `GET /forms/:slug` handler, ~:113014 in the installed bundle).
- `/_console/f/support`, signed out, en-US and zh-CN: a white page, React error #31 (an object rendered as a React child).
- Installed console: `assets/index-BQWjE1TW.js` maps the entry `label: e.label ?? i.label` and renders it through `fieldLabel(...)` from `assets/i18n-runtime-CSh2d7O_.js`. Neither resolves the map.

## Where it lands (read on objectui `origin/main` `241cb78bd`)

- `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` section builder (~:789–816): `label: override.label ?? def.label ?? override.field`, `placeholder: override.placeholder ?? def.placeholder`, `helpText: override.helpText ?? def.helpText`, all into `string` slots.
- The render sites (~:2227, ~:2242, ~:2535) pass `f.label` as the fallback of `fieldLabel(object, field, fallback)` (`packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` ~:355), which returns the fallback unchanged when no pack key matches. So the map reaches JSX.
- The file already records the gap for the form title (~:284): "`I18nLabel`, whose inline locale-map arm no form renderer in this repo resolves."
- The fix resolves an `I18nLabel` to the visitor's locale where the entry is built, with the console's existing localizer (the one `useActionTextLocalizer` uses for action copy), ⛔ not a per-site `typeof === 'string'` check that drops the map. Whether the server should resolve the map per `Accept-Language` instead is objectstack's question; the console must not crash either way.

## Done when

- A public form whose entry `label`, `placeholder` or `helpText` is an inline locale map renders, and en-US and zh-CN visitors each see their own string.
- The same holds on the signed-in form route that shares `FormPage`.
- A pin with a map on each of the three keys.

**Size:** S.

## Related

- The paired platform gap, filed in objectstack-ai/objectstack right after this card and linking back here: a form entry's label, placeholder and helpText have no translation-pack key. Today the inline map is the only way left to localize those strings, and this crash closes that way too.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (36) and every issue updated since 2026-10-09 (697, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged by hand) on 2026-10-23, and matched case-insensitively on their titles; the search API is refused for this session. Words: `public form`, `/f/`, `FormPage`, `React #31`, `error #31`, `I18nLabel`, `locale map`, `inline locale`, `placeholder`, `helpText`. Nearest hits: #12333 (closed, untranslated section titles on the public form), #13049 (closed, select defaults on the public form), #12358 / #12757 (closed, inline maps dropped in the grid and on `element:button`). None on point. **New.**
